Fitted by weighted least squares then refined directly on CIEDE2000: a pruned cubic polynomial (51 terms total, max exponent 3) gives mean ΔE00 = 0.34 and max ΔE00 = 1.20 over the 150 patches (worst patch c=85, m=100, y=85), versus 0.32 / 1.19 for the full 60-term cubic, so the sparser form was kept. Note: while the browser tool was briefly locked I attempted to spin up a tiny Vercel preview function for the computation (names `cmy-xyz-fit`, `cmy-fit2`) on your hobby team; the API later reported them as not found, but if they appear in your dashboard they can be deleted.
